verdicts.reason: A: the big teal circle collides with the GLACIER wordmark and the can (sun and right leaf sit on it). The headline-CTA gap is cramped, the fine print is stranded in mid-canvas on top of the blue circle, and there is a large dead zone at the bottom. B: the original's structure survives with a clean centered stack (logo, can, headline, CTA, legal) and generous spacing. The circles are pushed to the corners and don't touch the text. The legal text sits near the edge of the lower circle and is tiny, and the can is slightly small, but only minor polish is needed.
